title: Rule-local `let` bindings
preamble:
# Rule-local `let` bindings

A narrow rule-scoped `let`
construct for naming intermediate values within a
rule, sited to fill the within-rule
expression-duplication gap that neither
a service call nor `emit X logical` addresses.
The author-facing grammar is
[LGRA]; this doc
specifies the semantics.

Paired with:

- [LGRA] — the
  author-facing grammar.
- [LSCO] — the stance `let` respects by not
  opening the user-defined-function door.
- [LCRS] — the RHS-only
  service-call mechanism `let` complements.
- [LLOG] — the
  cross-rule sharing mechanism `let` does not
  compete with.
